propositions: Hand-maintained mirrors of canonical facts exist across src/rebar (enumerations, doc tables, schema fragments, hardcoded lists) and create representation drift defect sources.
A systematic grep and AST-based sweep of src/rebar must identify all candidate mirrors and classify each as a genuine mirror, distinct concept, or already gated.
Every genuine live mirror discovered must have a linked follow-up ticket proposing generation or gating using existing repo patterns.
The inventory report (reports/stability/mirror-inventory.md) must be committed with updated .gitignore rules to re-include reports/stability/ as a non-ignored subtree.
The sibling MCP↔library mirror story (cream-capitate-snake) is already filed and must be referenced rather than duplicated.
